items.name: tokens
items.title: Cremona tokens
items.description: The status tokens (success, warning, info) and the destructive foreground that the Cremona components use, in light and dark. The shadcn tokens they sit next to are untouched.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The text of a control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control it is for.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button: six variants, five sizes, and asChild to style a link.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, a description and an error wired for assistive technology, with vertical, horizontal and container-responsive layouts.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input, labelled, described and marked invalid by its Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content, labelled, described and marked invalid by its Field.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with an indeterminate state and a 24 px hit area, labelled and described by its Field.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A set of radio buttons with arrow-key choice and a 24 px hit area per item, each labelled, described and marked invalid by its Field.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off switch with a 24 px hit area, labelled and described by its Field.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A custom select with keyboard and type-ahead choice that submits with a form; its list is never taller than the room it has. Labelled, described and marked invalid by its Field.
items.docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label: a count, a status, a category. Seven variants, the status ones tinted with the status tokens; asChild to style a link.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in the page, announced at once for errors and warnings and politely otherwise, in five variants.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, a title, a description, an action, a content and a footer; the header reflows with the width of the card.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table that scrolls sideways inside its own region, focusable while it overflows and named by its caption.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with arrow-key navigation, horizontal or vertical, that scroll instead of overflowing on a narrow screen.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open and close, each trigger a button inside a heading of the level you choose.
items.docs: The animations use the accordion-down and accordion-up utilities of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog: focus trapped and returned, the page hidden from assistive technology, never taller or wider than the screen.
items.docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel next to its trigger that holds any content, with focus moved in and returned, capped to the room it has.
items.docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A hint shown on hover and keyboard focus, hidden by Escape and kept while the pointer is over it.
items.docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions with checkbox and radio items, submenus, keyboard navigation and type-ahead.
items.docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications with an imperative toast() and one Toaster to mount: announced to screen readers, paused on hover and focus, kept while an error or a choice is shown.
items.docs: Mount <Toaster /> once, near the root of your app, then call toast({ title: "Saved" }) from anywhere. The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.
